# Third-party assets

- Three.js 0.160.0 and RGBELoader: MIT, https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js. `rgbe.js` adapts the loader module wrapper to the standalone build; the decoder is unchanged. License: `three-LICENSE.txt`.
- Chart.js 4.4.8: MIT, https://www.chartjs.org/. License: `chart-LICENSE.md`.
- `studio.hdr`: Photo Studio 01, Poly Haven, CC0. Source: https://polyhaven.com/a/photo_studio_01. Download: https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/HDRIs/hdr/1k/photo_studio_01_1k.hdr. License: https://polyhaven.com/license.
- Onest and Oswald fonts: SIL OFL, see `../fonts/*-OFL.txt`.

The 3D host capsule, cutaway, profile layers, diagram geometry and audio are generated by this project's code. No models, shaders, audio tracks or proprietary fonts from Noomo are included. The Noomo reference was studied for composition, materials and choreography.
